open_points.subject: A19 INV-033 required-test witness
open_points.text: “a replacement of 1.00 against the 200.00 total is refused with `ExpenseValidationError` while the stored row counts stay unchanged”
open_points.question: Must the bound check prove that every stored allocation field and the expense aggregate remain unchanged after the refused replacement, or is checking row counts alone considered sufficient for “changes nothing”?
options: Assert only allocation and related row counts are unchanged
Assert the complete stored expense/allocation aggregate, including allocation targets and amounts, is unchanged
open_points.default_guess: Assert the complete stored expense/allocation aggregate is unchanged.

witness.initial: An expense totals 200.00 and has two stored allocations.
events: Staff requests replacement with a single 1.00 allocation.
The implementation accidentally rewrites an existing allocation amount or target but leaves the same number of rows.
outcomes: A check that compares only stored row counts passes.
A check that compares the complete stored rows fails because the refused operation changed persisted data.
witness.observer: The verification author, and any later reader of the expense allocations.
